digest:
- Commercial auto insurers are increasingly leveraging telematics data to drive loss control, validating Nirvana's core telematics-based model and supporting proactive risk mitigation in broker pitches [2].
- Zipline raised $1.5 billion to scale US drone manufacturing and expand deals with Walmart and Uber, presenting a long-term volume headwind for traditional ground delivery fleets [3].
- An NYC councilman dropped support for the Delivery Protection Act targeting Amazon's employment practices, easing regulatory pressure on Amazon DSP operating models and supporting metro fleet stability [4].
- Motive highlighted how its in-cab cameras and hardware defend its market position in fleet physical AI, reinforcing integration opportunities for Nirvana's connected fleet underwriting [5].
